tagline: CodeSage setup rules for the Python reference evaluator; production native integration is pending.
limitations: These rules are evaluated by the Python reference evaluator. Production native hooks do not consume them, and enabling the extension does not change native decisions.
Automatic doctor, status, and search inspection is not implemented in the native runtime; existing native review and block decisions still apply.
The listed operations and help variants describe Python reference matching only. Literal exec and xargs wrappers are covered; arbitrary inner executable paths are not.
